scope: Every current file in public/logos, including retained historical logos. Platform marks, fonts, Lucide and original Commonplace artwork are outside this manifest.
method: Local SHA-256 and byte counts; existing approved download records, public catalog documentation and embedded SVG metadata only. No upstream fetches or legal audit.

source_status_definitions.recorded_hash_match: Current bytes match a digest recorded with the source URL. This is not a new upstream verification.
source_status_definitions.documented_url: An exact source URL is recorded in public documentation; no matching saved download digest was available.
source_status_definitions.documented_path: URL reconstructed from a documented repository, branch and asset path; the resulting URL and remote bytes were not fetched.
source_status_definitions.download_attempt_only: An allowed script attempted this URL and documentation describes a consistent asset. Script presence does not prove a successful download or identity with current bytes.
source_status_definitions.source_gap: Exact current asset URL could not be established; source_url is null rather than guessed. See project_url and source_note.

modification_note: Local renaming is not an artwork edit. Unknown histories are explicitly unverified. CSS presentation is not a modification of the hashed files.
rights_note: owner_or_project identifies the associated project or embedded credits, not a verified legal ownership determination. Unverified terms do not mean public domain or permission to redistribute. Application code licenses are not used as artwork terms.
evidence_note: Repository-relative work/ paths name private local evidence consulted; no raw responses, scripts, images or research payloads are included. Public documentation and current asset hashes are self-contained.
